challenge.method: Tested whether the FAQ citation or the SPDX comment “Use GStreamer-exception-2008 instead” changes the identity, wording, or deprecation state of the 2005 record.
challenge.results: The generated 2005 record prints the distinctive original Totem sentences and sets isDeprecatedLicenseId to false. Its recommendation names a different identifier. The later FAQ example supplies no substitute witness for the text present in the dated header.

limitations: SPDX’s seeAlso points to the GStreamer licensing FAQ. The FAQ and the 2008 detail were not separately retrieved, so an exact comparison of their later wording is unverified. The positive 2005 match rests on the original header and the generated 2005 detail.
